page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr8i.6xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by the Intel Xeon 6462C processor. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz, paired with 192.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU, positioning the instance within the memory-optimized hardware class. The server operates on the KVM hypervisor.

The instance does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring reliance on external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by an 18 Gbps baseline bandwidth. Additionally, the instance does not bundle any complimentary public IPv4 addresses, and it does not feature any GPU hardware accelerators.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high memory density make this server suitable for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local storage IOPS. Appropriate workloads include relational databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-bound data processing tasks.
